#722753
INTEO DATE

MAY 21, 20257

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be

amended by changing all the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)

District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-N in the area bounded by
the public alley next north of and parallel to West Diversey Avenue; a line

197.10 feet east of and parallel to North Nordica Avenue; West Diversey
Avenue; and a line 147.10 feet east of and parallel to North Nordica Avenue

to those of a RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 7026 West Diversey Avenue
